a.xlink:title: BR-05: Employment must be active and tenure eligible.
BR-09: Company factor is 100% when its target is met, otherwise 50%.
BR-16: Add 75,000 cents for critical skills with good performance.
BR-08: Department factors are 110% engineering, 120% sales, and 100% operations.
BR-04: An active disciplinary hold blocks eligibility.
BR-19: Cap the bonus at the employee-specific budget allocation.
BR-26: Derive a reference from employee ID and payment cents only when payment is ready.
BR-21: Require manager approval and finance approval when required.
BR-01: Scores must be 0..100. A score above 50 passes.
BR-02: A score of at least 90 is exceptional.
BR-07: Base rates are 5% for clerks, 7% for specialists, and 8% for managers.
BR-11: Multiply annual salary by the role rate.
BR-25: Total compensation is annual salary plus the final bonus.
BR-03: At least 12 months of service are required.
BR-15: Add 50,000 cents for at least 36 months of service.
BR-06: Require eligible employment, good performance, clear conduct, and completed training.
BR-10: Exceptional performance multiplies the base by 150%, otherwise 100%.
BR-18: Ineligible employees receive a zero proposed payment.
BR-13: Apply the department factor after performance.
BR-14: Apply the company factor after the department factor.
BR-12: Apply the performance factor to the base bonus.
BR-17: Sum the company-adjusted bonus and both awards.
BR-20: Finance approval is required above 200,000 cents, strictly.
BR-22: Emit the capped bonus if approvals pass, otherwise zero.
BR-24: Emit approval_pending only for a positive bonus awaiting approval.
BR-23: Emit a payment-ready fact only for a positive final bonus.
